claim: hybrid VMM+LRU expert tier (golden-v2.0): prefill headroom and decode parity on one tier

rig.gpus: 4x RTX 5060 Ti 16GB, CPU-direct PCIe x8/x4/x8/x4 gen5, P2P via patched driver 615.71.09-p2p
rig.model: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next W4A16 int4 experts + FP8 PLE (Intel AutoRound target / albucino FP8-PLE assembly)
rig.parallelism: TP4 + EP4, np=1, batch-2 CUDA graphs, MTP off, 495K context (YaRN), pool 517858 (1.05x)

method.caveat_warm_vs_cold: the widely quoted 58.35 tok/s golden decode bar is a WARM session number; measured cold in this window the same arm reads 55.41
method.caveat_probe_depth: prefill below ~30k tokens is not a gate; deep prefill and recall are

narrative: docs/hybrid-vmm-lru-mechanism.md (contributed via the hybrid VMM+LRU pull request)
rollback: PREFILL_VMM_ARM=0 (mirror+LRU) or 1 (VMM-only) in .env + cold boot; module stays mounted and inert
provenance: measured in johnmosesventura06/qwen38-hybrid-vmm-lru on 4x RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB; arm 0 and arm 1 are unpatched baselines from the same window
